name: Offer validation (new service / product line inside an existing company)
mission: Validate a new offer with existing clients before building infrastructure for it.

stages.name: 0 · Define
stages.purpose: One-page offer: who, what, price, why now.

criteria.label: Target segment and 10 named target accounts

stages.name: 1 · Sell it
stages.purpose: Pitch to real accounts before building.

stages.name: 2 · Deliver manually
stages.purpose: Deliver the first three by hand; write the SOP while doing it.

stages.name: 3 · Systemize
stages.purpose: Hand it to an owner and productize.

kill_rules: Fewer than 3 commitments after 10 pitches → park and reposition.
